hypothesis: 本单一原片德语短CTA中，v4独立片尾ASR为Passt auf dich，v5复用相同TTS并联合调整人声增益和CTA背景约12dB衰减后，实际成片独立片尾ASR为Traust du dich。应对短CTA检查真实混音的首尾而非只核对TTS请求文字；这里只证明此次ASR可辨识度改善，不证明直接听审、每个单变量因果或跨源适用。
observation: Actual isolated encoded-tail model transcription changed from Passt auf dich to Traust du dich; same real TTS reused.
causal_hypothesis: Voice/background masking likely contributes; gain and ducking changed together, not separately controlled.
action_basis: One-source before/after actual encoded-audio comparison, no direct/native hearing.
limitations: One source and German only; ASR small model uncertainty
Does not approve visual repair, source soundtrack identity or normal-play/native quality
Not a company preference or activated method
evidence_boundary: Technical observation and hashes; raw private case is not needed to read this hypothesis. Activation requires independently packaged reviewed evidence.
